references.title: Cessna CitationJet/M2
references.author: Wikipedia contributors
references.scope: Secondary: wing area 30.66 m2, sweep 12.5 degrees.

calibration: No drawing. About 100 px/m near mid-body in the photograph, with a 0.03 image slope removed along the keel; fin heights scaled by 1.06 to reach 4.67 m.

comparisons: Side and three-quarter renders inspected against the photograph by eye. No overlay or matched camera was made.
corrections: Row width corrected from 1.47 to 1.62 m: 1.47 m was an interior figure.
Compact flight deck without the overhead panel, which came through the roof of a body this size.
Rectangular nacelles replaced with round FJ44 pods on stub pylons; wing rebuilt to 30.4 m2.
Seated eye moved from u 3.30 to 3.00 and h 1.42, where D-CEFE shows the pilot's head in the side pane. No published eye position was found, so this is an estimate.

Window top lowered from 1.66 to 1.58 and sill lowered about 0.05 m: D-CEFE shows the top about 0.17 m under the crown, and the old top read as a bubble canopy from outside. The stray post from 2.42 to 2.50 is removed: two panes a side.

Kit changes: glass clear from the seat and tinted from outside, as on the Bendy airliner. The thick glareshield slab and its large FLIGHT GUIDANCE lettering are replaced by a thin sloped hood with a rolled lip over a slim mode control strip. The panel, floor and overhead take their reach from the nose skin, and a dark coaming lines the inside of the nose.

limitations: Lowest-confidence group: no dimensioned drawing. External body size, tail span and engine station are read from one oblique photograph; wheelbase and tread rest on a dealer listing.
Exterior only: shared interior, refitted but not compared with a Pro Line flight deck.
Eye station and window limits are estimated from a three-quarter photograph, not measured.
Sanity pass only: seating, glass and visibility. The panel, hood and pedestal remain the shared kit interior fitted to the nose, not compared with this type's real flight deck.
